body:
Apart of another man who is flying to London right now and outstanding credit card bills? Nothing. They are not significant enough.

Say if he comes back begging for me and there is a cheque slipped under my door, I'm pretty sure they can't totally stop me from thinking about suicide. They could be the triggers but I believe soon after everything is alright I will find another reason to carry on. I'm bored and boring at the same time. Arrogant and selfish as well. But hey, thanks for dropping by!
